name: Zhejiang Hechuan Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Hechuan Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and application integration of industrial automation products in China and internationally. The company offers control technology, including programmable automation controllers (PAC)/industrial PC, programmable logic controller (PLC), and input/output; HMI products; servo drives comprising single and multi-axis products; servo motors; and variable frequency drive products. It serves the PV, laser, textile, packaging, woodworking, electrical and electronics, robot, and fluid industries. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Quzhou, China.
